messages:
mia_sales: Hey team — getting a last-minute Q from Acme about the on-prem POC. They want to ship via USB (sneakernet) and need clear guidance on: checksum signing, patch/upgrade cadence, and emergency hotfix paths. Can we confirm what we can promise in the SOW?
marcus_se: We can do signed bundles with an SBOM and SHA256 manifest. For USB, they expect immutable deltas, but we usually do full image + delta patches depending on size.
elaine_sre: Key ops note: offline installs require cert rotation guidance. If we sign with our CI key, customer needs to trust our root CA or we provide an offline signer flow. Also need to document rollback steps.
raj_se: Quick pricing Q from Acme: do we bill on bundle delivery or on applied upgrades? They want a flat per-device maintenance for offline sites.
david_legal: From a contract POV, we can offer a monthly per-device support fee covering up to N offline deltas and 24/7 hotfix SLA. Need to flag export controls if bundles include certain libs.
marcus_se: Technical constraints: for large models we strongly recommend chunked bundles (tar + manifest) and a resumable apply utility. Example command we recommend to validate on-site before apply:
```
sha256sum -c redwood-bundle.manifest && ./apply-bundle --verify-signature --dry-run
```
mia_sales: Can we define "hotfix" window? Customer asks if we can ship a signed patch within 24 hours for critical security issues.
elaine_sre: 24h SLA for signed hotfix delivery is OK for enterprise contract with elevated support. But offline activation depends on customer ops — shipping the USB is on their schedule. We'll document an expedited signing + airgap checklist.
david_legal: Add clause: emergency modifier for expedited signing with separate fee. Also require acceptance of tamper-evident chain-of-custody for physical media.
raj_se: For upgrade cadence, recommend quarterly regular updates + monthly security deltas. Keep quantized model bundles stable between major releases to avoid re-quantizing every patch.
marcus_se: Also note cache/kv state migration: if model format changes across upgrade, we need a compatibility shim or plan to purge KV cache — include step in runbook.
mia_sales: Can we ship a short checklist for Acme today so they can sign off on SOW? They want exact phrasing for "offline bundle verification" and "rollback path".
elaine_sre: I'll draft a 1-page checklist: pre-apply checksum, signature verify, dry-run, snapshot config, apply, smoke tests, rollback. Will include commands and expected durations.
marcus_se: I'll add the packaging notes: chunking, manifest format, max bundle size recommendations, and sample delta strategy.
david_legal: I'll prepare wording for the emergency modifier and chain-of-custody acceptance.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note recorded — created ticket SALES-7892 for POC deliverables (checklist + packaging doc + contract clause).
mia_sales: Awesome — if you can drop drafts here by EOD I'll consolidate and send to Acme. :thumbsup:
